open_item: USA signed off 2026-11-05 (labels-v2). JPN/DEU: verify quarterly non-residential GFCF components during collection; if unavailable the component counts as missing.
decision_taken: Strict: business (non-residential) fixed investment only. Total GFCF is not substituted; where business investment is missing the component counts as missing. USA (labels-v2): constructed real non-residential business fixed investment = (Y033RC1Q027SBEA + B009RC1Q027SBEA + Y001RC1Q027SBEA) / (A008RD3Q086SBEA/100); GPDIC1 retired.

open_item: Verify official retail series for IND and CHN.
decision_taken: Real retail trade volume, or retail sales deflated by headline CPI from the same chain source. No unofficial proxy (cards, GST e-way bills, auto sales) substitutes; missing stays missing.

open_item: USA signed off 2026-11-05. JPN/DEU: verify quarterly total hours; annual-only data remain missing under Q-05.
decision_taken: Quarterly total hours only. Annual-only means the component is missing; no temporal disaggregation. USA (labels-v2): keep HOANBS (nonfarm-business total hours), the only full-coverage quarterly total-hours series on FRED; sector coverage documented.

open_item: Part 4: download the MoSPI/RBI candidates, fill data/india_core_coverage.csv, and record the final 6/8 count; the structural failures already make 6/8 unreachable.
decision_taken: No. §19 is applied uniformly with no relaxation for any country. A country that fails gets no BEAI-based Label A; it stays in coverage reporting. Labels B and C remain robustness labels, not substitutes. Pre-audit (2026-11-05): India's best case is 4/8 - GDP and consumption pass, industrial production and investment likely pass, and employment, hours, income and retail are structurally missing - so India is Label-B-only under O-2 pending the final download audit.

open_item: Check MoSPI for the published back series and the legacy quarterly start date.
decision_taken: Collect legacy (2011-12 and earlier) and new (2022-23) series; splice by chaining log growth rates over the overlap quarters; no level splicing; record overlap, break dates and back-series status in base_year_changes.
Same splice rule as Q-07. If both WPI and the new PPI exist, collect both; the series with the longer continuous history is primary.

open_item: Confirm there is no continuous pre-2017 all-India quarterly series.
decision_taken: Re-label fiscal quarters to calendar quarters at ingestion (FY Q1 = Apr-Jun = calendar Q2). Pre-2017 employment and unemployment stay missing: no backcasting and no survey-round interpolation.

open_item: Verify NBS/OECD availability and start dates.
decision_taken: No special treatment. NBS -> OECD -> BIS; where no level is published, build an index by chaining NBS SA q/q growth (documented); eligibility is decided by §19 like any country; reliability concerns are documented, not used to exclude.

open_item: Confirm whether BOJ hosts JGB yields; check the latest ESRI dating.
decision_taken: 'Official' = the compiling agency's series reached through BOJ Time-Series Data Search, e-Stat or ESRI. Series produced by private bodies (JSDA yields, Nikkei 225) are not official: use the next chain source (OECD) unless official hosting is confirmed. ESRI reference dates: use the §65 list as given and check for a newer release.

open_item: Resolve dataflow IDs for each indicator.
decision_taken: Use OECD Data Explorer/SDMX only for OECD-chain rows. Do not use FRED copies of OECD/BIS data for non-US countries. Spread queries to stay under 60 per hour. Record dataflow IDs and versions at retrieval.

open_item: Resolve series keys, coverage and gap documentation.
decision_taken: Record the BIS download date as data_version_id. Use the BIS gap only if its filter is confirmed one-sided; otherwise compute an own one-sided gap inside training windows.

open_item: Verify FRED hosting of UMCSENT, NFCI, VIX, credit spreads, EPU; confirm whether ISM PMI is hosted.
decision_taken: Access-source rule: a series is in scope if a §7 source hosts it, whatever its original producer (e.g. University of Michigan sentiment, VIX, NFCI via FRED for the USA). Producers reachable only outside §7 are excluded (non-US EPU, Excess Bond Premium). PMIs (listed in §25) are conditional: kept only where a §7 source hosts them (NBS for China); otherwise excluded after the verification pass.

open_item: Check each provider's terms in Phase 3.
decision_taken: No redistribution of restricted raw files; the repository holds retrieval scripts and metadata only.

open_item: Verify India/China equity coverage and a market-cap/GDP source.
decision_taken: Nominal broad price index from the chain, used as log returns and volatility; no real conversion. Market cap/GDP is annual and carried forward with a 1-year lag (Q-31); priority P2 (a candidate per §65; no committed sign, so not a major predictor).
OECD CCI/BCI are the harmonised surveys. National surveys only where a chain source hosts them (BOJ Tankan, RBI surveys). No outside substitution.

open_item: Run the pass; fill every PENDING_VERIFICATION field.
decision_taken: Run a metadata-only verification pass in Phase 3 (FRED API, OECD SDMX, BIS bulk download, BOJ API, RBI/MoSPI/NBS downloads) and record the retrieval date. It cannot be done from this environment, which has no direct network access to those APIs.

open_item: Digitise the chronologies with retrieval dates; check for a newer ESRI release.
decision_taken: As a separate reference table used for plausibility checks only; ESRI dates from §65 as given.
